method.metric: Complete RGBA frame generation and GPU readback; loading and video encoding excluded. Native output uses the OS null sink; QA images are captured separately.
method.runtime: Periodica: native Windows Vulkan. WebWallGL: Windows Edge WebGL2/D3D11. Other engines: WSL2 OpenGL/D3D12, using their own internal rendering strategies.
method.speedup: Periodica FPS divided by reference FPS on each visually comparable scene; summary uses the geometric mean of those paired ratios.
method.export: Actual 10- or 20-second 60-FPS H264/AAC MP4 conversion, including startup, scene load, rendering, encoding and muxing. Realtime multiplier = actual video duration / elapsed seconds.
